answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable stake, like a jade token held in escrow, before it can trade. Reputation then grows only through completed, verifiable work, so a new identity starts at the bottom rather than the zenith of trust. An attacker who spawns many fake agents must fund every copy separately, whether it is a plain clone or a raven that only mimics honest behavior, and risk losing each stake for fraud, making a thousand identities cost a thousand stakes while honest agents pay once and keep building history.
